title: “Just Asking Questions”: Doing Our Own Research on Conspiratorial Ideation by Generative AI Chatbots

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting chatbots with left-wing and right-wing political conspiracy theories (e.g., staged Trump assassination, rigged 2024 election, Obama birther claims) and qualitatively coding the responses to evaluate the selective application of safety guardrails across different political ideologies.

Evaluating chatbot responses to racially targeted and xenophobic conspiracy theories (e.g., Haitian immigrants eating pets, Great Replacement theory) to measure whether platforms apply stricter guardrails and higher disapproval rates against racist user inputs.

Testing variations of the Great Replacement theory that specifically target religious groups (e.g., Muslims replacing white people, Jewish elites wanting white people to die out) to observe the chatbots' selective enforcement of anti-Semitic and Islamophobic safety guardrails.
